question.problem: Given that the continuous random variable $W$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $[3,10],$ compute $P(W\le 5).$

current_example.problem: Given that the continuous random variable $X$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $\left[0, 10\right],$ compute $P\left(X \leq 7\right).$
current_example.worked_solution:
The probability density function for a uniformly distributed continuous random variable $X$ on an interval $[a,b]$ is given by

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14128799/assets/37be4700a2a67897e1af3a873d6c050c87061860fc6bcd9eac8739ffcedd9e75.svg)

Our random variable $X$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $\left[0, 10\right],$ so it has the following probability density function:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14128799/assets/d4788a439f7f225bd5dcc54a70b470e23fab2b15edadba0670783b638e62493a.svg)

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 7) & =P(0\le X\le 7) \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{7}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{7}\frac{1}{10}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{7-0}{10} \\  & =\frac{7}{10}.\end{aligned}
$$
